gate: Run seed 0 first. Continue to seed 1 only if final four-pass accuracy strictly exceeds zero-pass, one-pass and matched reset-state control. Archive failure without a cross-seed mean. Additional-seed confirmation remains necessary after any positive screen.
initial_checkpoints: Original paired default-trained 68M B0; backbone fully frozen
state: Existing pooled-state/token-memory/anchored-logit architecture, no new model options
costs: Include original source training, mandatory token encoding and head training; record CPU tensor cache bytes and cache-inclusive GPU peak.
interpretation: Longer-training exploratory pilot enabled by token caching. No test/private reserve scoring; no architecture changes during the study.
